answer: [REDACTED] is one work-unit contract (the catalog's 19 mandatory fields plus min_tier and capability_needs) and one artifact contract (output_path, output_schema by path, SUCCESS:<id>/FAILED:<id> sentinel, AND-gate of exit 0 plus parsable schema-valid bytes). [REDACTED] and [REDACTED] adapters publish typed capability descriptors and a NON-EMPTY leak register. Negotiation computes missing = needs not offered; a unit with min_tier=GUARANTEED and any missing capability terminates FAILED:[REDACTED]-demo-guaranteed-[REDACTED] DOWNGRADE-REFUSED capability=tools.mcp.[REDACTED] vendor=[REDACTED] min_tier=GUARANTEED rather than degrading. The same unit against a vendor that has the capability yields NEGOTIATED:[REDACTED]-demo-guaranteed-[REDACTED] vendor=[REDACTED] missing=0 leaks=3. GUARANTEED fields are identity, inputs, graph, artifact path/schema/sentinel, evidence/tests/reviewer/owner-gate text. BEST-EFFORT fields are timeout, retry, substrate, and failure-class mapping. VENDOR-ONLY fields are assignment and tool_permissions. The FIRST inexpressible construct is treating vendor-native tool names (mcp__codex__codex vs Read/Grep/Glob) as a GUARANTEED-identical tool_permissions vocabulary; we stop there and do not claim vendors are interchangeable.

leaks.text: Windows CreateProcess caps the command line at 32,767 characters. A measured inline prompt of 34,472 died with OS error 206. Prompts MUST go by file, never inline.

Fire-and-forget --background loses the result. IMP-0421: a work-unit dispatch must be structurally unable to run detached. Exit 0 with an empty/missing last-message file is severed-stream, not SUCCESS.
mcp__codex__codex is vendor-only. [REDACTED] Read/Grep/Glob are not [REDACTED] tools. Schema-invalid output while MCP tools are active is a measured failure class ([REDACTED]).

downstream_consumers.note: Measure runs after this emit and after named probes.

capability_needs.justification: Declared capability ids are the negotiation input. Computed intersection, not asserted (IMP-0419 evidence_requirement).

min_tier.justification: Every unit must declare the minimum tier it needs. Missing min_tier FAIL-CLOSED. Adapters may not infer a lower tier.

evidence.claim: Every one of the 19 catalog work-unit contract fields is assigned to exactly one of GUARANTEED, BEST-EFFORT, VENDOR-ONLY.
A unit declaring min_tier=GUARANTEED that needs tools.mcp.[REDACTED] is REFUSED on the [REDACTED] adapter and ALLOWED on the [REDACTED] adapter; empty leak registers are INVALID-ADAPTER.
Each tier assignment is justified against an observed vendor behaviour difference with a citation on this worktree.
Library files 09-WORKFLOW-BLUEPRINT-LIBRARY.json and 12-COUNCIL-PROTOCOLS-AND-PRESETS.json were read from disk on this worktree.
Vendors are interchangeable at the tool_permissions field; mcp__codex__codex and Read/Grep/Glob are the same GUARANTEED vocabulary.
Live [REDACTED] MCP dispatch was executed on this Linux box.

expressibility.cardinality_reason: 09-WORKFLOW-BLUEPRINT-LIBRARY.json and 12-COUNCIL-PROTOCOLS-AND-PRESETS.json are absent on this worktree. ROSTER.json and RUBRIC.json are also absent. Expressibility is shown on three catalog-cited samples, not on library cardinality.
expressibility.catalogue_claim: Skills, workflow blueprints, and council presets are expressible as [REDACTED] work units that declare min_tier and capability_needs over the 19-field catalog contract
expressibility.first_non_expressible_construct: vendor-native tool names (mcp__codex__codex vs Read/Grep/Glob) treated as a GUARANTEED-identical tool_permissions vocabulary
expressibility.stop_reason: tool_permissions vocabularies are not identical: [REDACTED] lists Read/Grep/Glob/Write; [REDACTED] units list mcp__codex__codex. Encoding those names as GUARANTEED-identical would be the interchangeability lie. We stop and document the leak instead of claiming a common tool algebra.
expressibility.structural_rule: A capability is expressible iff it can be wrapped as a work unit whose capability_needs are named in CAPABILITY_TIERS and whose min_tier is honored by negotiate() without rewriting tool names.

Exactly-one-tier assignment per contract field, with citations.
Capability bits plus mandatory leak register for [REDACTED].

FAIL-CLOSED on GUARANTEED miss. Never silent downgrade.

negative_controls.description: GUARANTEED unit needing tools.mcp.[REDACTED] dispatched to [REDACTED] must REFUSE with DOWNGRADE-REFUSED; the same unit to [REDACTED] must ALLOW; a silent_shim that returns SUCCESS/DEGRADED is not the live path; an adapter with an empty leak list is INVALID-ADAPTER.

precedence.duplicate_in_one_file: FAIL-CLOSED: a field listed in two tiers, or a duplicate capability key in one adapter, invalidates the file and dispatch aborts.
precedence.merge: No field-level merge of vendor descriptors. No silent union of tool names into a fake common vocabulary.
precedence.rule: A unit's min_tier is a floor. An adapter MUST NOT lower it. A missing GUARANTEED capability is FAIL-CLOSED (FAILED:<id> DOWNGRADE-REFUSED), never DEGRADED or SUCCESS.
precedence.tie_break: If TIERS.json and an adapter descriptor disagree on whether a surface is GUARANTEED, the VENDOR-ONLY declaration wins and the surface MUST NOT be advertised as GUARANTEED.

question: Specify the [REDACTED] layer: one work-unit and artifact contract with per-vendor adapters, capability negotiation, and EXPLICIT abstraction-leak documentation. Define three tiers - what is guaranteed identical across vendors, what is best-effort, and what is vendor-only - and require every work unit to declare the minimum tier it needs so a unit is never silently downgraded.

residual_unknowns.claim: Byte-level semantic equivalence of a live [REDACTED] vs [REDACTED] run of the same GUARANTEED unit.
residual_unknowns.settling_experiment: That is [REDACTED]'s job: produce two artifacts that both pass the predicate yet differ semantically. This design refuses to claim they will match.

retry.policy: two strikes then pivot: after two failed attempts on the same framing, enumerate at least two alternative decompositions before a third attempt (AGENTS.md 4b)

reviewer.method: Probe1 re-reads catalog.contract.work_unit_fields (19 names) from disk and checks set-equality against TIER_ASSIGNMENTS and DESIGN.tier_map. This is the catalog tier-completeness test, not a second human architect.
reviewer.paired_adversarial_note: [REDACTED] depends on this DESIGN.json plus [REDACTED]..[REDACTED]. Waiting for [REDACTED] before closing [REDACTED] is a deadlock; G-1 for this unit does not require that circle.

transcription.note: Four named roles as static prompt sections. Portable as a work unit that needs only GUARANTEED capabilities. Does not require mcp.[REDACTED] or [REDACTED]-only Grep.
Finite declarative stages. Expressible as a GUARANTEED unit so long as tool_permissions stay in the portable fs.read/fs.write set, not vendor-native tool names.
Declarative roles/voting/stopping. Progress-not-result is BEST-EFFORT: a vendor that emits a progress stream must not treat it as the terminal artifact.

tests.name: Tier-completeness check: every field of the work-unit contract is assigned to exactly one tier
Downgrade-refusal test: a unit declaring tier GUARANTEED dispatched to a vendor lacking the capability must FAIL LOUDLY rather than degrade

assignment.justification: assigned_model_vendor_role binds vendor+model+role. [REDACTED] is [REDACTED]/[REDACTED]/architect; [REDACTED] is [REDACTED]/[REDACTED]/adversarial-refuter. Pretending these are the same assignment is the interchangeability lie [REDACTED] exists to refute.

completion_sentinel.justification: [REDACTED] requires every dispatch to end in SUCCESS:<id> or FAILED:<id> <reason> and never in silence. Progress streams are not sentinels (measured failure class on this estate).

dependencies.justification: The catalog graph is vendor-neutral. Adapter-side 'close enough' substitution of a dependency is a silent downgrade.

evidence_requirement.justification: The evidence bar is the unit's, not the vendor's. A vendor that cannot produce a cited measurement must FAIL, not lower the bar.

execution_substrate.justification: [REDACTED] declares local-parallel; IMP-0421 [REDACTED] adapter declares local-serialized; IMP-0419 declares worktree-isolated. Substrate labels are not interchangeable. The adapter should preserve the unit's declared substrate when the host can, and leak when it cannot.

failure_classification.justification: The catalog taxonomy is shared, but vendor error vocabularies differ: Windows OS error 206 / win-arg-limit vs [REDACTED] tool-error vs MCP schema-invalid-while-tools-active ([REDACTED]). Mapping into the unit's declared classes is best-effort; unmapped errors must surface as FAILED:<id> unmapped-vendor-error, never as SUCCESS.

id.justification: Unit identity is the dispatch key and the sentinel suffix. Both vendors must round-trip the same id; renaming at the adapter is a contract break, not a flavour difference.

inputs.justification: Declared input paths are the unit's closed file set. An adapter that silently drops an absent Windows restore path and continues would hide NOT-CHECKED as SUCCESS.

output_path.justification: G-1 delivery is existence+parse of this path. [REDACTED] AND-gate (IMP-0421) already measured that exit 0 without the file is severed-stream, not SUCCESS. The path is therefore identical across vendors.

output_schema.justification: [REDACTED]'s schema-parity test requires both vendors' artifacts to validate against the identical schema file, by path. Schema substitution is a lie.

owner_approval_required.justification: Owner gate is program policy. An adapter must not infer approval from a vendor-native 'auto-run' flag.

phase.justification: Phase is program metadata (Phase 3 tournament for [REDACTED]). It is not a vendor runtime property.

retry_policy.justification: Catalog retry for [REDACTED] is 'once on win-arg-limit with --ignore-user-config and --prompt-file; never --background'. [REDACTED] native dispatch does not share CreateProcess 32767. The portable intent (no silent retry into a verdict; prompt-by-file) is best-effort; the [REDACTED] flags themselves are vendor-only.

reviewer_requirement.justification: The declared reviewer constraint (independent architect; paired [REDACTED] refutation) is catalog text. Fulfillment is scheduling; the field's meaning does not change by vendor. Waiting on [REDACTED] before G-1 of [REDACTED] is a deadlock and is recorded as such, not rewritten.

target.justification: The work statement (live key question_or_target) is the same text whichever adapter runs. Vendor paraphrase of the question is an abstraction leak and is forbidden at GUARANTEED.

tests_required.justification: The two catalog tests (tier-completeness; downgrade-refusal) are the same predicates on every adapter. Skipping a test because a vendor lacks a tool is a silent downgrade.

timeout_seconds.justification: IMP-0420 requires the declared timeout to be the one applied, not a default. Kill/cancel mechanisms differ (process kill vs API cancel vs MCP tool abort). The adapter must try to honor the integer; residual mechanism difference is a documented leak.

title.justification: Human-readable identity travels with the unit. Adapters may not rewrite the title to match a vendor-native job name.

tool_permissions.justification: [REDACTED] lists Read/Grep/Glob/Write. [REDACTED] units list mcp__codex__codex. Those names are not a common vocabulary. Treating them as GUARANTEED-identical is the first inexpressible construct: vendor-native tool names as a portable permission set.
